description: Search condos for rent or sale in Bangkok by budget (THB), bedrooms, BTS/MRT station or line, walking minutes to the station, district and size. Returns the matching listings with their bkkradar.com links and the same search on the map. Show the links to the user.

lang.description: Language of the titles and links: en, fr, th, ja (Japanese) or zh (simplified Chinese). Use the user's language.

limit.description: Listings to return, 20 by default, 50 at most.

line.description: Line code or name ("BTS-SUK", "BTS Sukhumvit", "MRT Blue"), or a whole network: "BTS", "MRT".

max_price.description: Maximum price in THB (per month for rent).

max_walk_minutes.description: Walk to the listing's nearest BTS/MRT station, at most, in minutes (straight line at 80 m a minute). With a station or line and no value: 12 (1 km).

min_size_sqm.description: Living area, at least, in m².

property_kind.description: Kind of property; any for all.

sort.description: recent (newest first), price (cheapest first) or walk (closest to the station first).

station.description: BTS/MRT station name or code, e.g. "Asok", "Phrom Phong", "BTS-CEN".

name: search_condos
title: Search condos in Bangkok
